tools.name: store_code
tools.description:
Store an encrypted OAuth2 authorization code.

Called by the serverless callback function after the browser redirect.
The code is encrypted with SHA-256(state) before storage.

Args:
    code: The authorization code from the OAuth provider.
    state: The state token (patron npub) from the authoriza

tools.name: retrieve_code
tools.description:
Retrieve a stored authorization code (one-time read, auto-deleted).

Called by the originating MCP server to pick up the code after the user
has authorized in the browser. Returns the encrypted code which the
caller decrypts using the same state token.

Args:
    state: The state token (patron npub)

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: service_status · Private data: store_code, retrieve_code, service_status · Public sink: service_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: service_status · Private data: store_code, retrieve_code, service_status · Public sink: service_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
